text: bab IMAGINE in your mind a great and powerful kingdom, or principality, in which all freely and with one consent conspire to direct their actions, agreeably to the will and command of one supreme king, the oldest and the best : and then suppose the bounds and limits of this empire not to be the river Halys, nor the Hellespont, nor the Mœotian lake, nor the shores of the ocean; but the heaven above, and the earth beneath. IHere then let that great king sit immoveable, prescribing laws to all his subjects, in which consist their safety and security. And thus you see how the order and chain of this government descend down by steps and degrees, from the Supreme God to the earth and men.
